gaps: Men's Swimming & Diving: never appears in any CSCAA DII poll on cscaa.org (checked every DII poll post 2016-17 through Sept. 2026 preseason); no NAIA poll appearance before 2014-15.

Women's Swimming & Diving CSCAA DII March 8, 2024 final poll: Biola entered the Top 25 but the exact rank is not in any fetched source (cscaa.org post and SwimSwam/Wayback copy lack the women's table with Biola).
CSCAA DII December 2023 poll: no post found on cscaa.org; Biola status unknown for that edition. CSCAA polls 2019-20 through 2021-22 fetched and Biola absent.

NAIA swim poll 2014-15 men: NAIA ratings-history PDF lists Biola 10th in the Dec. 11, 2014 poll but the contemporaneous Jan. 22 release lists Biola's previous rank as NR; Dec. 11 row omitted. The PDF's 2014-15 men's table disagrees with the Jan. 22 release for several other teams too.
NAIA swim polls before 2012-13 were Top 5 only; Biola not listed in any 2002-03 to 2011-12 poll in the NAIA PDFs. NAIA 2017-18 onward: Biola absent (NCAA transition).
Men's Water Polo: no appearance (ranked or receiving votes) in any CWPA men's varsity national Top 20 poll 2021 through Week 4 2026. WWPA 2024 men's preseason poll placement not found.
Women's Water Polo: CWPA women's polls 2021-2026 all checked; appearances only 2023 final, 2024, and early 2025. 2026: none through the final poll.

ITA DII tennis team rankings: no primary ITA documents fetched (wearecollegetennis.com is JS-rendered); all NCAA-era tennis rows are biola-news with story dates, not release dates. Weekly ITA ranks for weeks between stories (e.g., men 2022 Feb 16-Mar 23, men 2026 weeks 3-6, women 2022 late season, women 2023-2024) are missing. ITA West Region team rankings only found for men 2020 (No. 8) and women 2021 (No. 4).

NAIA tennis: week-by-week PDFs (naia.org records) cover Top 25 only; RV appearances for men 2014-2016 come from Biola stories without exact poll dates. Biola's 2010 story says the women had not been ranked since 1999, but the NAIA PDF shows a No. 17 ranking on March 10, 2004 (conflict). Men's 2011 (27th) and 2012 (28th) 'final poll' placements are outside the published Top 25.

Golf: NAIA week-by-week men's and women's golf poll PDFs contain no Biola entries. Women's golf WGCA DII polls not fetched from wgcagolf.org; all golf rows are biola-news. Several golf ranks (No. 21 Mar 2022, No. 26 Apr 2022, No. 25 Feb 7 2023) do not name the ranking system. Men's golf: only a 2009 Golfstat/NAIA head-to-head ranking found; no NCAA DII (2014-19) rankings found.
Biola news archive coverage before ~2013 is thin (few stories per year), so NAIA-era news-sourced rankings are likely incomplete.
Women's Flag Football: first season 2028; no rankings (skipped).
